entries.0bdc87e4eb2231bb: This equipment performs dry processing to microfabricate materials such as semiconductor thin films and insulating films on various substrates. In equipment that uses Tornado ＩＣＰ, high-density plasma is generated stably, enabling high-speed, high-precision microfabrication. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥7,004 million.
entries.34bab9920dc2e6d9: This equipment performs dry cleaning of mounted circuit boards and various semiconductor substrates without using solutions. It includes Aqua Plasma cleaning equipment, a plasma treatment equipment that uses water vapor. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥832 million.
entries.7818dcdb47c4dca1: This equipment supplies reactive gases onto a substrate and forms thin films through chemical reactions. It includes ＬＳ－ＣＶＤ equipment, which uses liquid source materials, and atomic layer deposition (ＡＬＤ) equipment. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥1,440 million.
entries.7e6c5859d15d4fe2: Semiconductor and Other Electronic Component Manufacturing Equipment Business
entries.87d0bd22971000f4: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells semiconductor and other electronic component manufacturing equipment. It manufactures and sells ＣＶＤ equipment that forms thin films, etching equipment that microfabricates thin films, cleaning equipment that cleans substrate surfaces, and other equipment, and provides parts and maintenance services. Manufacturing is outsourced to cooperating companies based on the company's own design planning; before shipment, the company inputs its own proprietary program software, and after specification and shipment inspections, the products are sold. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥10,800 million.
entries.967dddf0717f6285: A company that manufactures and sells thin-film deposition and processing equipment used in the manufacture of semiconductors and electronic components.
entries.cda306073dcf2b57: This is the sale of parts and maintenance services. Maintenance service operations centered on Taiwan are outsourced to the local subsidiary Shamuke Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥1,523 million.
